appDescription: AnyPic is a batch image compressor that runs entirely on this computer.

pngTipText: Lossless compression; the quality setting does not apply.

permissionBody: Allow AnyPic in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording (older systems call it Screen Recording). If the switch is already on but this keeps appearing, select AnyPic, remove it with “−”, then capture again and allow it once more. Quit and reopen AnyPic after allowing it.
permissionManual: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording manually
